body.resource_hint: For a symmetric bilinear density D[phi], hidden exchange gives D[g-phi]=D[phi]-2B(phi,g)+D[g], g=lambda^-1 log(psi/lambda). At phi=0 choose psi_t=lambda*t*exp(lambda*f). Every finite psi jet tends to zero with t, while the pair Fourier coefficient of D[g] at k1+k2 is the nonzero quadrupole coefficient of f and is independent of t. Hence the parity image and its even/odd projections have no regular continuous extension to psi=0. On two mirror sheets use G=kappa=swap and the block-diagonal mirrored density; G*kappa=I, the density is ghost-even and Hilbert-selfadjoint, and normalized symmetric source/detector projections retain the single-sheet response rather than doubling it. This is a changed doubled theory, not public Eq. (19).
